event: In experiments on Gemma-2-9B, Llama-3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B, the researchers traced contextual knowledge selection to interacting sparse-autoencoder features across layers. They reported that identifying causally connected key paths filtered redundant features; steering relevant features increased attention to context tokens containing the answer, and knowledge selection formed across multiple layers. (Renmin University of China and Nanyang Technological University research team, 2026-10-24.)
